name: @nivo-lite/plugin-registry
description: What is installed in this app: the lists of the core package and of every plugin package, joined by defineInstallation into `installed` (modules, blocks, nodes, jobs, entities, registryHash), and the lazy renderer of every installed block (./client). Both entries are GENERATED by scripts/build-plugin-registry.mjs; the front end, the door, the graph host, the job runner and the entity engine are wired from them.
